evidence: This is stated as established knowledge from preclinical studies.

claim: GDF15 levels have been demonstrated to provoke nausea-related pica and CTA responses in rat and mice, respectively.

evidence: This is cited from Borner et al., 2020a; Patel et al., 2019.
